metadata.reason: The current HWPX task and the existing Campus Energy Balance task are dissimilar in domain (Document Automation vs. Spreadsheet Calculation) and technology (XML/HWPX vs. Excel/Formulas), providing negligible transfer prior.

Both tasks involve template-based automation of HWPX documents, requiring XML manipulation of the package structure, handling fragmented placeholders in <hp:t> tags, and clearing <hp:lineSegArray> to prevent stale layout issues. The logic for replacing placeholders and managing the ZIP-based HWPX file format is highly transferable.

Both tasks require low-level XML manipulation within the HWPX ZIP structure, specifically targeting content.hml. The techniques for parsing fragmented XML text nodes, removing stale layout caches (lineSegArray), and repackaging the HWPX file used in the training feedback task are directly applicable here.

Both tasks follow an identical multi-step spreadsheet orchestration pattern: 1) Multi-modal lookup (INDEX/MATCH) of source data into multiple target blocks, 2) Row-wise derived calculations (Net SLA/Energy), and 3) Final weighted aggregation using SUMPRODUCT. Techniques for handling absolute/relative referencing within Excel grids are directly transferable.
